description.it: Schede il cui genere o classe non esiste più nella configurazione: vanno riclassificate.
description.en: Records whose genre or class no longer exists in the configuration: they need reclassifying.

sql: SELECT b.title AS title, b.author AS author, CASE WHEN b.kind = 'fiction' THEN b.genre_code ELSE b.class_code END AS code FROM biblio b WHERE COALESCE(CASE WHEN b.kind = 'fiction' THEN b.genre_code ELSE b.class_code END, '') NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(:classificationCodes)) ORDER BY b.title
